description: Observed review presets of Codex CLI's `codex review`, keyed by CLI version. The hash is SHA-256 of the reviewer system text (the block beginning 'You are acting as a reviewer for a proposed code change') as recorded in the child thread's session_meta base_instructions, hashed as UTF-8; rubric_bytes is its byte length. file_attempt.py computes the hash. A run manifest records which entry each Codex attempt matched; an unmatched hash is a new preset to register before the attempt counts.

0.156.1.default_reasoning_effort: none (as the CLI header reports it)
0.156.1.rubric_marker: You are acting as a reviewer for a proposed code change
0.156.1.output_contract: stdout: summary paragraph, then 'Review comment:' bullets `- [P<n>] <title> — <path>:<start>-<end>` with an indented body; the child rollout's final JSON carries overall_correctness
notes: `codex review --base <branch>` refuses a prompt; the range and the packet go on stdin (`codex review - < prompt`) and the rubric still applies.
The review runs in a child thread (thread_source subagent, parent_thread_id set); the parent rollout records no usage.
Under a clean HOME the preset still walks up the tree probing for AGENTS.md and AGENTS.override.md; the clone's ancestors must hold none.
The sandbox is read-only by default for an untrusted directory and workspace-write for a trusted one; the run pins it explicitly.
